report:
S2-S4 sacrum, segmental / wide resection

Received in formalin is a segmental / wide resection specimen of the S2-S4 sacrum measuring 11 x 9 x 7 cm (en bloc sacrectomy specimen). Sectioning shows a gelatinous / myxoid and haemorrhagic tumour measuring 72 x 58 x 45 mm. The tumour destroys the cortex and extends into the adjacent soft tissue. Macroscopically, the tumour lies 0 mm from the closest (anterior epidural margin) margin. Representative sections are taken in 12 blocks after formic acid decalcification.

(1-9) Tumour.
(10) Proximal sacral osteotomy.
(11-12) Anterior epidural margin.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Segmental / wide resection
- Tumour site: Spine (S2-S4 sacrum)
- Tumour location and extent: Medullary cavity; Cortical; Tumour extension into
  soft tissue
- Tumour size: 72 mm (greatest dimension)
  - All dimensions: 72 x 58 x 45 mm
- Vertebral extent: Extension into the spinal canal

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Conventional chordoma
- Histologic grade: Not applicable
- Mitotic rate: 2 per 10 HPF
- Necrosis (in absence of neoadjuvant therapy): Not identified
- Treatment effect: No known presurgical therapy
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the S2-S4 sacrum show conventional chordoma. Lobules of cords and nests of epithelioid cells with prominent intracytoplasmic vacuoles (physaliphorous cells) lie within an abundant basophilic myxoid stroma. Tumour cells are diffusely positive for brachyury, pan-cytokeratin (AE1/AE3) and S100.

Margins
- Surgical margins: Involved by tumour (anterior epidural)
  - Anterior epidural: involved (block 11)
  - Proximal sacral osteotomy: Uninvolved, 12 mm (block 10)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT4a

Additional findings
- Preresection treatment: No known preresection therapy

S2-S4 SACRUM, segmental / wide resection:
- CONVENTIONAL CHORDOMA, 72 mm
- Surgical margin involved by tumour (anterior epidural)
- pT4a (AJCC 8th edition).
